description: This file defines the PotCommand class responsible for UI components and logic related to potentiometer (pot) management, including resistance calculations and command issuance for a Java Swing interface within a larger engine control project.

classes.name: PotCommand
classes.description: A UI component class for managing potentiometer settings in a Java Swing interface, including resistance calculations and command communication.

methods.name: PotCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the potentiometer control panel with related sliders, labels, and event listeners.

methods.name: requestPotChange
methods.description: Static method to send a command to change the resistance of a specific channel's potentiometer.

methods.name: getPotResistance
methods.description: Static method calculating resistance based on output voltage, reference voltage, and engine load resistance.

methods.name: getRbyD
methods.description: Static method converting a digital value to resistance in ohms.

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDivider3
methods.description: Static method calculating the resistance in a voltage divider circuit based on output and input voltages and a load resistance.
